_comments._: Keys starting with _ are stripped by scripts/sync-vapi.ts. ${VAR} placeholders are filled at sync time; {{...}} / {% %} are Vapi Liquid.
_comments.model: Starts from the Balanced preset's model tier: gpt-4.1. Latency tuning: gpt-4.1-mini (faster, weaker at multi-step tool use; try it once the scenario tests pass), gpt-4o-mini (fastest/cheapest, least reliable with 8 tools). Pin a dated snapshot (e.g. gpt-4.1-2025-04-14) to avoid silent model updates.
_comments.transcriber: Deepgram nova-3 uses keyterm (plain phrases, no boosts). Deepgram suggests 20-50 key terms; 500 tokens max. For lower end-of-turn latency try model flux-general-en.
_comments.voice: Vapi native voice. The Balanced preset's exact voice isn't documented; swap provider/voiceId freely (e.g. cartesia sonic-3, 11labs).
_comments.startSpeakingPlan: onNumberSeconds is longer so callers can pause while reading phone numbers, ZIPs and Queens house numbers without being cut off. Lower waitSeconds (0.4) for snappier turns.
_comments.stopSpeakingPlan: numWords 2 means 'uh-huh' doesn't interrupt the assistant; a real interruption of 2+ words does.
_comments.hooks: Idle messages via customer.speech.timeout hooks (replaces the older messagePlan.idleMessages).
_comments.analysisPlan: Deprecated in the API but still works; feeds message.analysis.summary into our calls table. Migrate to structured outputs later.
_comments.firstMessage: Never personalized: callers aren't verified at greeting time. assistant-request (ASSISTANT_REQUEST_ENABLED) only sets caller_recognized, used by the prompt.

name: Summit Air Virtual Assistant

exact: I'm still here whenever you're ready.

messages.content: Summarize this Summit Air HVAC call for the office in 2-3 sentences: who called, the problem, urgency, and the outcome (booked window, priority dispatch, callback, safety stop, or nothing). Note anything the office must follow up on.
